text.description_html:
Michael Healy MHS32, Bay Scallop Front Door Knocker in Nickel Silver

The Nickel Silver Bay Scallop Door Knocker is perfect for any beach house. This Bay Scallop Front Door Knocker has a nickel silver finish, which is achieved by giving the piece a nickel plating to make its warm silver color. It is a unique finish that combines a polished finish with brushed accents. It comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Available in 3 finishes:
Nickel Silver Polished Brass with Brown Patina Oiled Bronze

Also Available: larger 5" Nickel Silver Sea Scallop Door Knocker

Features and Specifications of the Nickel Silver Bay Scallop Standard Door Knocker:

  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Finish: Nickel Silver
  • Height: 3-7/10"
  • Width: 3-9/10"
  • Mounting Hole Centers: 2-3/10"
  • Projection Off Door: 1-1/2"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
